name: 任务空间合同
contract: X/Y、测量算子、约束、正则性、范数、适定性与目标

en.name: Task-space contract
en.contract: X/Y, measurement operators, constraints, regularity, norms, well-posedness, and objectives

name: 采样和重构
contract: P_h/R_h、坐标、单元体积/求积权重、跨分辨率映射

en.name: Sampling and reconstruction
en.contract: P_h/R_h, coordinates, cell volumes/quadrature weights, and cross-resolution mappings

name: 算子/查询读出
contract: 给定函数观测与查询位置输出场/轨迹；按任务加入局部或全局核

en.name: Operator/query readout
en.contract: Output fields/trajectories from function observations and query locations; add local or global kernels as required by the task

name: 残差质量与稳定因子
contract: 残差范数、经验/可靠级别、条件数或稳定常数的来源

en.name: Residual quality and stability factors
en.contract: Residual norms, empirical/reliable status, and provenance of condition numbers or stability constants

name: 误差—成本自适应
contract: 将候选动作映射到预期误差下降/代价，验证后再接纳

en.name: Error–cost adaptation
en.contract: Map candidate actions to expected error reduction/cost, and accept only after validation
